title: Open Problems in Integrable Systems — Quantum integrability for polynomial in momenta integrals
exact_target: Which metrics allow every polynomial integral of geodesic motion to become an exactly commuting differential operator with the same principal symbol?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2100710 (AMR-020-0710). CC BY 4.0.

Alexey Bolsinov, Vladimir S. Matveev, Eva Miranda and Serge Tabachnikov, Open Problems, Questions, and Challenges in Finite-Dimensional Integrable Systems (2018), Problem 7.11 and its complete preceding definitions. Original question and full discussion.
